posts.cooked:
So, I was playing with SkyScraper & Fixer against the Chairman, and I had SkyScraper play Catch-a-Ride, using Fixer to atttack.

Fixer swung for the fences, and then... nothing.  No irreducible damage, no choice of who to do the 2 damage to.

Is this a bug, or is there something I'm missing here?

Fixer killed off the last target, but there were still 3 targets that he'd dealt damage to that were in play.

posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
This actually may be working as intended.

Jackhandle actually replaces what would have been the original attack with the new attack jackhandle creates. There is a rider clause on Catch-a-Ride that requires the first attack to have happened and dealt damage for the 2nd attack to activate. Since the first attack from CaR never happened (since it was replaced by the jackhandle effect for a different attack) it seems to me that the condidtion for the 2nd effect was never actually met.

Strange edge case here! It certainly would seem intuitive that CaR's 2nd attack would occur, and thats very likely how I would play it live on the table. But it doesn't surprise me thats how it works in the game due to how Jackhandle is coded.

phantaskippy wrote:
Was the first target you hit with it destroyed?  The first target (or last target) you hit would be the one most likely to cause the computer to not process the second hit, because the target didn't survive the initial hit.  
The first target was the Operative (I think MAY have been a Corrupt Cop who was killed, can't remember), who was still in one piece (then.  I turned her to paste later).The last target was a mook (not a Corrupt Cop, not a Goons).I'll see if I can replicate the issue later.

OK, I was able to replicate, eventually. 

My first game, CAR came out after Sparky flipped.  The last target (as well as some others) died. I was given the choice of who SkyScraper was to hit. I hit rewind, and tried it again, killing the first target.  Still got the choice.

So I restsarted until I had CAR and Micro-Assembler in hand, so I could make sure to try it with an unflipped Chairman.

On her second turn, SkyScraper played CAR.

The first target I hit was an unflipped Chairman, and I did NOT get the option of choosing who SkyScraper was to hit.

I rewound, and hit The Operative first, and was given the choice of who SkyScraper was to hit.

So it seems that if the very first target doesn't take damage, Catch A Ride doesn't trigger.
